effectenrekening.definition: The account your investments are held in.

ewma.definition: A weighted average of the last twelve months, with recent months counting more.

meerwaarde.definition: Tax on the gain realised when selling an investment.

mwr.definition: Return that includes the timing of your deposits, so it measures your outcome.

pensioensparen.definition: Tax-advantaged retirement saving with an annual ceiling.

reynders.definition: Tax on the interest component of certain bond funds when you sell.

roerendeVoorheffing.definition: Tax withheld at source on dividends and interest.

ter.definition: The yearly percentage a fund deducts from its assets.

tob.definition: Belgian tax charged on each purchase or sale of a security, at a rate that depends on the instrument.

twr.definition: Return that ignores the timing of your deposits, so it measures the investments.
